newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share market rebounds on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share market rebounds on technicals.

text.p: Technicals lifted the Singapore stock market to close firmer across most sectors on Wednesday, albeit in thin volume, dealers said.
"We did not see selling pressure apart from some foreign fund selling of blue chips this morning," a dealer with a European bank said.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index rebounded from its intraday low at 2,116.60 to end 19.42 points up at 2,135.46, 6.42 points off its intraday high.
Market volume was light, at 70.4 million shares, with gainers edging losers 157 to 156.
Nippecraft Ltd topped the actives with 4.2 million shares.
SIA Ltd Foreign and Keppel Corp led gainers, rising S$0.30 (US$0.21) each, to S$14.00 and S$10.50 respectively.
Malaysian-linked Perlis Plant, Malaysian Assurance and Innovest Bhd led decliners, shedding S$0.25 to S$0.36.
Dealers said Malaysian counters eased on continued forced selling seen in Kuala Lumpur since Tuesday.
"Foreign funds seem to be getting out of the various regional markets in turns, except for Hong Kong," a dealer said.
The UOB OTC Index, tracking Malaysian counters traded here, ended 4.10 points down at 1,179.81.
